{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageOps
im=Image.open('/app/documents/F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg').convert('L')
w,h=im.size
# row ink counts threshold
for thr in (200,160,100):
    print('threshold',thr)
    runs=[]; inrun=False
    for y in range(h):
        c=sum(1 for x in range(w) if im.getpixel((x,y))<thr)
        ink=c>3
        if ink and not inrun: start=y; inrun=True
        if not ink and inrun: runs.append((start,y-1)); inrun=False
    if inrun:runs.append((start,h-1))
    print(runs[:50])
# crops around content runs
for name,box in [('top',(0,250,w,1000)),('mid',(0,900,w,1500)),('bottom',(0,2000,w,h)),('fullink',(300,280,1100,1000))]:
    c=im.crop(box)
    c=c.resize((c.width*3,c.height*3), Image.LANCZOS)
    c=ImageOps.autocontrast(c)
    c.save('/tmp/prep/'+name+'.png')
    print(name, c.size)
PY
for n in top mid bottom fullink; do echo "===== $n psm6 ====="; tesseract /tmp/prep/$n.png stdout --psm 6 2>/dev/null; echo "===== $n psm11 ====="; tesseract /tmp/prep/$n.png stdout --psm 11 2>/dev/null; done"}
